integrity: The stated infinite formula is supported by a direct upper construction and a two-case lower-bound proof from the defining strong Roman condition. The literature comparison treats total strong Roman domination and k-strong Roman domination as distinct parameters and records residual indexing risk rather than claiming exhaustive bibliographic uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts. The bipartite case is not claimed. Finite verification covers all part profiles through order 10 and supplements, but does not replace, the symbolic proof.
title: Strong Roman domination of complete multipartite graphs with at least three parts
